title: StateGraph ignores reducers wrapped in ReadOnly TypedDict qualifiers
observed_behavior: A state field declared as ReadOnly[Annotated[list[str], operator.add]] loses its reducer: the sequential graph returns only the last node's ['b'], and the parallel variant raises InvalidUpdateError at 'findings'.
structure_focus: Reducer discovery through TypedDict qualifier wrappers (ReadOnly/Required/NotRequired) on a fan-in/fan-out key
notes: Open, label external. Two-node graph run once sequentially and once with START fan-out; no model or external service. Root cause is framework qualifier unwrapping before channel/reducer discovery, not the graph shape, so a fixture written with the public API shows the structure but cannot reproduce the failure on a fixed version. The issue includes a focused patch and test matrix.
